info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Secret Rotation Management API
info.description: The Secret Rotation Management API facilitates the secure rotation of sensitive secrets used within microservices. Organizations can automate the process of updating and managing secrets to enhance security and compliance. This API is designed for developers and security teams looking to integrate secret rotation into their applications, ensuring that secrets remain protected against unauthorized access. Typical use cases include scheduled secret updates and dynamic configuration for applications requiring frequent secret changes.

post.summary: Rotate the secret for a specific webhook endpoint.
post.description: This operation allows you to rotate the secret associated with webhook endpoint RES-100045. It ensures that the security of the webhook is maintained by updating the authentication token used for secure communications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to rotate the secret for a specific webhook endpoint identified by RES-100045. The payload contains the details necessary to generate a new secret, ensuring the security and integrity of the webhook communication.
